Order No.02 / Dated : 04.02.2026.
Heard both the sides.

This bail application has been filed on behalf of Ravi Kant Kumar who is in custody since 01.07.2025 in connection with Adityapur P.S. Case No. 197 of 2019 for the offence registered under Sections 376, 498A, 323 and 34 of the IPC pending in the Court of learned C.J.M., Saraikela, is pressed into motion.
The prosecutrix is a married lady, aged 33 years, having two children who lodged this FIR against her husband, the present petitioner who is her brother- in-law and another co-accused-Umesh Singh.
It is alleged that at the instance of her husband, she was forced to have physical relationship with the co-accused persons including this petitioner.

It is submitted by the learned counsel on behalf of petitioner that the prosecutrix had eloped with one person against whom the petitioner had lodged FIR and in counter blast the present case has been filed.
It further submitted that husband of the prosecutrix and the co-accused have already been granted bail by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court.
Learned A.P.P. for the State opposed the prayer for bail.

Under the circumstances, the above-named petitioner is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/-(Twenty-Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the Court below.
